summary: AWS Activate Credits: Activate Founders (self-funded/bootstrapped) starts at $1,000 with select participants qualifying up to $5,000; Activate Portfolio (pre-Series B, via an Activate Provider Org ID from an accelerator/VC) offers up to $200,000. Credits work across AWS services including Amazon Bedrock (incl. third-party foundation models); additional AI-startup credits are invite-only. Eligibility: pre-Series B, founded within the last 10 years, AWS account on Paid Tier plan, and either new to Activate or requesting more credits than previously received.
claim_steps: Create/confirm an AWS account on the Paid Tier plan.
Founders (self-funded): apply directly at aws.amazon.com/startups/credits. Portfolio: apply with your Activate Provider's Org ID.
After approval, apply credits to eligible AWS usage including Amazon Bedrock.

social_proof.title: AWS Activate Credits
social_proof.text: Apply for up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits, with additional credits available for AI startups ready to scale. Activate Founders: Up to $5,000 USD — start with $1,000 USD. Activate Portfolio: Up to $200,000 USD — you must have an Organization ID (Org ID) from your Activate Provider.

social_proof.author: Ksenia Moskalenko
social_proof.text: @awscloud will give your startup up to $200K in cloud and AI credits, and the entry tier requires nothing but a website. @AWSstartups has given $7B since 2013. Founders (self-funded): start with $1,000, up to $5,000. Portfolio (VC-backed): up to $200K. Credits cover Amazon Bedrock (Claude, Llama, Mistral). No equity required.
